ancestry_limits.independence: Closure components are embargo units, not proven IID. Large connected components are reported, not split.
ancestry_limits.internal_holdouts: Derived from official TRAIN; not official dev/test and not blind policy OOD
ancestry_limits.partial_full: Partial preview and full packet share source ancestry; never claim them independent. Partial fitting before full closure freeze would contaminate future full holdouts.
ancestry_limits.pretrained_contamination: Not audited; no pretrained model opened here

feature_protocol.graph: Only observed turn order/speaker; all-service schema branch is a separately declared protocol. No current-gold frame edges.
feature_protocol.privacy: deterministic text-only regex and capitalized-name heuristic; no annotation-span markers. Values masked if not unchanged and visible in sanitized observed window.
feature_protocol.schema_descriptions: All official TRAIN service schemas made available separately to every example; never select schemas using current gold frames. Current frame service is a target/supervision mask only.
feature_protocol.schema_is_transactional: publisher metadata only; no bank authority

target_protocol.actions: actual published USER action types and arguments; canonical values not exposed
target_protocol.active_intent: namespaced service-local CE; published NONE retained
target_protocol.belief_updates: Consecutive USER frames for same service only; observed KEEP/SET map deltas supervise only if value identity recoverable. DELETE always unknown/masked: no independent annotation completeness certificate.
target_protocol.requested_slots: service-local schema order BCE only when requested_slots field exists
target_protocol.slot_presence: publisher state dictionary membership only; mask requires slot_values dictionary

checks: all annotation mutations leave input unchanged
